title: 第4章 无耻
slug: 似锦全本免费-似锦最新章节列表
content_zh:
季崇易是老来子，比季崇礼小了十多岁，加上生来体弱，全家人都把他捧在手心上，从小到大，季崇易想要天上的星星家里人都恨不得给他摘下来。
季崇礼目光移向紧挨着季崇易而站的巧娘身上。
季崇易上前一步把巧娘挡在身后，维护之意分外明显。
季崇礼不由跺脚：“三弟，你真是糊涂啊，你这样做对得起父母吗？”
季崇易抿唇不语，反而握住巧娘的手。
众目睽睽之下，季崇礼不好斥责，冷脸道：“罢了，先回府再说！”
“我要带巧娘一起回府。”季崇易开口，声音沙哑。
季崇礼狠狠瞪了季崇易一眼，吩咐管事善后，匆忙带着季崇易与巧娘走了。
留下来的管事向众人团团抱拳作揖，取了一百两面额的银票交给众人公认德高望重的一位老者，带着剩下的人匆匆离去。
一百两银子对前来救火的百姓来说可不是小数目，众人当时便把老者围得水泄不通，商量起该如何分配来。
阿蛮趁机溜到与姜似约好的地方，见姜似头上包着的黑色布巾已经湿透，小声问：“姑娘，您没事吧？”
“没事，把准备好的烧纸撒了，咱们赶紧回去。”虽然入了夏，可此时是夜里，姜似又刚从水里出来，被风一吹就觉得凉透了，嘴唇已经发白。
阿蛮忙依言行事。
“姑娘，好了。”
姜似点点头，主仆二人趁着混乱悄然离去。
路上，阿蛮气愤难捺：“姑娘，季三公子真是太过分了，明明都是要和您成亲的人了，怎么能……怎么能和别的姑娘那样呢？”
紧贴在一起的唇，急促的喘息声……
想到在湖边看到的情景，阿蛮就觉恶心又愤怒。
姜似只是笑笑，没有作声。
这一次，她再也不会嫁过去了。

季崇易若能娶巧娘为妻，并一直如此相待，她还能高看他一眼。
毕竟人蠢也是有闪光点的嘛。
没有得到姜似的回应，阿蛮依然咽不下这口气，抿嘴一笑道：“还好姑娘让婢子准备了烧纸，就当给那对奸夫**烧的好了，嘻嘻。”
姜似睨了阿蛮一眼：“那些烧纸有别的用处。”
“什么用处？”阿蛮好奇问道。
夜风吹来，从头巾中散落下来的两缕碎发已经被吹干，正调皮挠着姜似白皙如玉的面颊。
姜似脚下不停，把碎发捋到耳后，望着远方更浓郁的夜色道：“总要给湖边伞亭起火找个过得去的理由应付官差。”
阿蛮双眼发亮：“还是姑娘想得周到。”
小丫鬟转而又想到了季崇易，撇嘴道：“季三公子真是有眼无珠！”
“好了，别提他了，到家了。”
墙角的洞依然被挡在草木后，阿蛮拨开青草，小声道：“姑娘，您先进吧。”
姜似俯身从洞口爬了进去，待直起身来，表情不由一滞。
离她不足一丈之处有个人正往前走，显然也是刚从洞口爬进来的。
这个时候阿蛮也爬进来了，一看前面有人不由惊了，虽然赶忙捂住了嘴巴还是发出了声响。
前面的人身体一僵停下来，猛然转身：“谁——”
姜似手疾眼快捡起洞口旁散落的土砖，对着那张熟悉的脸就拍了过去。
没错，这人就是她那不学无术的兄长姜湛。
姜湛一声惨叫，仰头倒下。
阿蛮看清了姜湛的脸，声音都抖了：“姑，姑娘，您怎么把二公子拍死了？”
“他没事，快走！”

姜似对自己的力道把握还是有数的，知道这一下顶多让姜湛昏迷片刻，不会有大碍，且姜湛那声惨叫无疑会把人引来，这样就不怕他昏迷太久躺在地上着凉了。
果不其然，很快不远处就亮起了灯，有人出来查看动静了。
姜似带着阿蛮沿着原路飞快返回，推开虚掩的侧门再从内把门锁上，确定没有留下破绽，这才悄悄回到海棠居。
院中的海棠花开正艳，娇红浅白，月光如霜落在那些花瓣上，美得惊心动魄。
姜似的院中只栽了海棠树。
人们都遗憾海棠无香，她却恰恰喜爱这一点。
她的嗅觉天生超出常人，一直处于浓烈的花香中会让她不适。
“阿巧，我们回来了。”阿蛮轻轻扣门。
阿巧拉开门把姜似与阿蛮迎进来，见二人全都无恙，不由露出欢喜的笑容：“姑娘，婢子早已准备好了热水，请您沐浴吧。”

content_en:
Ji Chongyi is an old man, more than ten years younger than Ji Chongli, and he was born with a frail body. The whole family holds him in the palm of their hands. Ever since he was a child, Ji Chongyi wanted to pick the stars in the sky and his family wanted to pick them for him.
Ji Chongli's eyes moved to Qiao Niang, who was standing next to Ji Chongyi.
Ji Chongyi stepped forward and blocked Qiao Niang behind him, his intention to protect her was very obvious.
Ji Chongli couldn't help but stamp his feet: "Third brother, you are so confused. Are you doing this worthy of your parents?"
Ji Chongyi pursed his lips and said nothing, but held Qiao Niang's hand.
Under the gaze of everyone, Ji Chongli couldn't bear to scold him and said with a cold face: "That's it, let's go back home first!"
"I want to take Qiao Niang back home with me." Ji Chongyi said, his voice hoarse.
Ji Chongli glared at Ji Chongyi fiercely, ordered the steward to deal with the aftermath, and hurriedly took Ji Chongyi and Qiao Niang away.
The steward who stayed behind bowed to everyone, took a hundred taels of silver notes and gave them to an old man who was recognized by everyone as having high moral character, and left in a hurry with the rest of the people.
One hundred taels of silver was not a small amount for the people who came to put out the fire. The crowd immediately surrounded the old man and discussed how to distribute it.
Aman took the opportunity to sneak to the place where he had made an appointment with Jiang Si. Seeing that the black cloth wrapped around Jiang Si's head was soaked, he asked in a low voice: "Girl, are you okay?"
"It's okay. Scatter the prepared burning paper and let's go back quickly." Although it was summer, it was still night. Jiang seemed to have just come out of the water. He felt chilled by the wind and his lips were already white.
Ah Man was busy doing as he was told.
"Girl, it's ready."
Jiang Si nodded, and the master and servant took advantage of the chaos and quietly left.
On the way, Ah Man couldn't hold back his anger: "Girl, Mr. Ji San is really too much. He is obviously the one who wants to marry you, how can...how can he be like other girls?"
Lips pressed together, rapid breathing...
Thinking of what he saw by the lake, Ah Man felt sick and angry.
Jiang Xi just smiled and said nothing.
This time, she will never marry again.
If Ji Chongyi could marry Qiao Niang and treat her like this all the time, she would still be able to look up to him.
After all, even stupid people have their bright spots.
Not getting a ginger-like response, Ah Man still couldn't swallow his breath. He pursed his lips and said with a smile: "Fortunately, the girl asked the servant to prepare burning paper, just treat it as burning for the adulterers, hehe."
Jiang Si glanced at Ah Man: "Those burning papers have other uses."
"What's the use?" Ah Man asked curiously.
The night wind blew, and the two strands of broken hair that had fallen out of the turban had been blown dry and were playfully tickling her ginger-white cheeks.
Jiang Si kept walking, stroking his broken hair behind his ears, looking at the thicker night in the distance and said: "There must be a decent excuse for the fire at the umbrella pavilion by the lake to deal with official duties."
Aman's eyes lit up: "The girl is still thoughtful."
The little maid then thought of Ji Chongyi and curled her lips and said, "Young Master Ji is really short-sighted!"
"Okay, don't mention him, we're home."
The hole in the corner was still blocked by grass and trees. Ahman pushed aside the grass and whispered: "Girl, please go first."
Jiang Si leaned over and crawled in through the hole. When he straightened up, his expression couldn't help but freeze.
There was a person walking forward less than a foot away from her, who had obviously just climbed in through the hole.
At this time, Ah Man also crawled in. He was startled when he saw someone in front of him. Although he quickly covered his mouth, he still made a sound.
The person in front froze and stopped, then turned around suddenly: "Who——"
Jiang Si's hands and eyes quickly picked up the scattered mud bricks near the entrance of the cave, and patted the familiar face.
Yes, this person is her unlearned brother Jiang Zhan.
Jiang Zhan screamed and fell down.
Aman saw Jiang Zhan's face clearly and his voice trembled: "Girl, why did you beat the second young master to death?"
"He's fine, let's go!"
Jiang seems to be still confident about his own strength.They know that this will at most make Jiang Zhan unconscious for a moment, and there will be no serious harm. Jiang Zhan's screams will undoubtedly attract people, so there is no fear that he will lie on the ground and catch cold after being unconscious for too long.
Sure enough, soon a light came on not far away, and someone came out to check what was going on.
Jiang Si led Ah Man back along the original road quickly, pushed open the ajar side door and locked it from the inside. After making sure that there were no loopholes, he quietly returned to Haitang Residence.
The begonia flowers in the courtyard are in full bloom, delicate red and light white. The moonlight falls like frost on the petals, which is breathtakingly beautiful.
Only crabapple trees were planted in the ginger-like courtyard.
People regret that Begonia has no fragrance, but she just likes this.
Her sense of smell is naturally superior to that of ordinary people, and being exposed to the strong scent of flowers all the time makes her uncomfortable.
"Ah Qiao, we are back." Ah Man gently knocked on the door.
Ah Qiao opened the door and welcomed Jiang Si and Ah Man in. Seeing that both of them were fine, she couldn't help but smile happily: "Girl, my maid has already prepared hot water. Please take a bath."
